items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A cat called me from New York, Clarence... He had the group called the Enforcers... I just can’t think of Clarence’s last name.

ctx.x: Yeah. So three. I said, for Pete’s sake. A cat called me from New York, Clarence – what was the name? A saxophone player, good saxophone player. Clarence.
